subject: Access governance playbook & artifact handoff for HealthNova
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthnova.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Risk Compliance <audit@riskcompliance.io>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated access governance deliverables

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Our security team asked me to request a single deliverable bundle that maps Redwood's access governance controls to our SIG/SOC 2 needs. Specifically we're looking for: 

- A short "playbook" that outlines what artifacts you can provide for SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning deltas, and RBAC/least-privilege evidence.
- Representative SAML assertion samples and short instructions on how to generate them.
- A sample SCIM delta (CSV or JSON) showing deprovisioning and role changes for a 30-day window.
- A table of role definitions + least-privilege justification for common admin/user roles.

Can you confirm what you can deliver by EOB Mon (May 3)? If you can include filenames and a GDrive link, that would help our intake ticket.

Thanks,
Elena
Security Operations | HealthNova
elena.torres@healthnova.com

---
HealthNova Confidential - do not distribute externally without prior consent
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthnova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated access governance deliverables

Elena — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Sean (CS ops) and Jonas (IAM) so we can put together a concise package. High level plan: 

1) Playbook PDF (one-pager + appendix) that maps controls to SIG sections and SOC 2 criteria.
2) Attach SAML assertion examples and a small script/instructions to pull a live assertion from a test tenant.
3) SCIM delta sample (we'll redact PII) as CSV showing create/update/delete events for users and groups.
4) RBAC table with role names, last-reviewed dates, and least-privilege rationale.

Sean / Jonas — can you confirm you have the SCIM delta export and SAML samples? Prefer we deliver as a single zipped folder to the Drive link Mina will share.

Elena — we'll aim to deliver the bundle by EOB Mon May 3 PST. If anything slips, we'll flag it by EOB Sun.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Solutions | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthnova.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated access governance deliverables

All — I pulled the SCIM delta for 2027-04-01 through 2027-04-30 from the onboarding/provisioning pipeline. Attached is a redacted CSV (scim-delta-sample-20270501.csv) that includes: 
- event_time, event_type (create/update/delete), user_email (redacted), previous_roles, new_roles, source_connector

Jonas, I also exported three representative SAML assertions from our dev tenant (saml-assertion-samples.txt). Those include the NameID and role claims we usually provide. Mina, I've added a short README that explains how the assertion was captured and the minimal steps to reproduce it in a test environment.

Attachments: scim-delta-sample-20270501.csv (CSV stub), saml-assertion-samples.txt (text), access-governance-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF stub)

Next steps: Mina, if you can assemble the playbook PDF and upload everything to the shared Drive folder, I'll verify the CSV headers match HealthNova's intake template (JIRA-1234).

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

> On May 1, 2027, Mina wrote:
> > Elena — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Sean (CS ops) and Jonas (IAM) so we can put together a concise package.
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@healthnova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Risk Compliance <audit@riskcompliance.io>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: consolidated access governance deliverables

Elena — attaching the consolidated playbook bundle we discussed. Contents uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_playbook-HealthNova

Bundle contents (zipped folder):
- access-governance-playbook-v1.pdf — one-page playbook plus appendix mapping to SIG/SOC 2 rows
- scim-delta-sample-20270501.csv — redacted delta export (create/update/delete)
- saml-assertion-samples.txt — three short assertion examples, with claim mapping notes
- role-definition-table.csv — role_name, permissions, least_privilege_justification, last_reviewed
- README_playbook.md — quick reproduction steps and contact points

We also included a short-runbook for internal reviewers that explains how to validate an assertion and how to request a fresh SCIM export. If Risk Compliance needs a signed cover letter or additional attestation, please let us know and we can route to legal.

Next steps: Elena, please confirm that the files meet HealthNova's intake requirements (JIRA-1234). If everything looks good, I can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with your team to show how to reproduce the SCIM export.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Compliance Solutions | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: access-governance-playbook-v1.pdf (pdf), scim-delta-sample-20270501.csv (csv), saml-assertion-samples.txt (txt)
